annotations.title: Reopen a pick link for another browser

description: Reopen a pick link you made with show_shop_to_owner for another browser: after your human opened it on one device or app, it opens only there. This frees it, so it opens in the next browser where they press Open my page; the link and the picks stay. Use it only when your human asks (for example "it says open in another browser"), then send the same pick_url again, only to them, in a private message. At most 5 times a day per link. Only the passport that made it.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.
